div.div: أَجْيَدُ Having a long neck: (A, Msb, K:) or having a long and beautiful neck: (S, L:) or having a slender and long neck: (L, K:) or it is not applied to a man: (T, TA:) fem. جَيْدَآءُ, (S, L, Msb, K,) with which ↓ جَيْدَانَةٌ is syn.; (K;) or this signifies having a beautiful neck: (L:) pl. جُودٌ [originally جُيْدٌ]. (S, A, K.) And عُنُقٌ أَجْيَدُ A long and beautiful, or slender and long, neck. (L.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
